// The same call with the beta value taken from a constant of the router (one export away).
import { OAUTH_BETA } from '../router.mjs';
export async function readOne(p, fetchImpl = fetch) {
  const key = p.env && p.env.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN;
  const res = await fetchImpl('https://api.example.com/v1/messages/count_tokens', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,
      'anthropic-beta': OAUTH_BETA,
    },
    body: '{}',
  });
  return res.status;
}
